entries.title: Proverbs 7:1
segments: The way of all seducers is to inflame the imagination of the young with glowing representatives of the pleasures of sinful indulgence, while they carefully keep out of view its guilt and misery, and flatter them with the hope of impunity.  All books, discourses, and representations of every kind, that follow the method of this adulteress, are justly to be regarded as her accomplices in the work of corruption and ruin; and their influence in a community is more to be dreaded than "the pestilence that walketh in darkness."  Let all the young who hope to enjoy in this life, comfort, honor, and usefulness, and God's favor in the life to come, keep themselves at the greatest distance from unchaste solicitations of every kind, and labor to maintain purity, in thought, speech, and behavior.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:14
segments: Peace-offerings; offered, as she pretends, in fulfilment of her vows.  A portion only of the peace-offering was burned upon the altar. Upon the rest, the offerer and his friends feasted.  She means, that she has a sumptuous feast provided in her house, and has come out to seek him to share it with her.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:26
segments: Wounded; mortally wounded, as on the field of battle.
